name: ensemble
description: Ensemble: run JavaScript workflow scripts over Codex, Claude and opencode workers, so one model family can check another's work. Ships the ensemble-workflow skill with its bundled launcher.

interface.shortDescription: Author and run cross-engine multi-agent workflows
interface.longDescription: Ensemble runs JavaScript workflow scripts over AI coding agents on three engines — Codex, Claude and opencode — so one model family can check another's work in a single run. The bundled ensemble-workflow skill teaches writing and running workflows, dispatching a single worker on a chosen engine, fallback chains, named targets and the dispatch remap, decision holds, and reading a run's record.
defaultPrompt: Use the ensemble-workflow skill to have a Claude worker review the change a Codex worker makes.
Dispatch a single Codex worker through Ensemble to summarise this repository.
